name: com.choreoff/choreoff
title: ChoreOFF
description: Local home service pros, typical prices and open home jobs near a U.S. ZIP. Read only.

tools.name: find_open_jobs
tools.description: Real home service jobs homeowners posted on ChoreOFF near a U.S. ZIP that still have a spot for a pro to send a price. Use when a home service pro asks for jobs, leads or work near them. Shows the job, the town, timing, how long ago and spots left. Never shows homeowner contact details.

job.description: The work, like "snow removal", "junk removal", "painting" or "roofing".

tools.name: how_choreoff_works
tools.description: How ChoreOFF works for home service pros: free to join and free to send prices, the connection fee only when a homeowner picks you, and who gets whose contact details when.

tools.name: start_joining
tools.description: A link to join ChoreOFF free as a home service pro, with the work and ZIP filled in. Use when a pro wants to sign up or get job requests.

job.description: The work, like "snow removal", "junk removal", "painting" or "roofing".

tools.name: find_local_pros
tools.description: Local home service pros on ChoreOFF who do a job near a U.S. ZIP: business name, town, rating from homeowners who hired them, their own price, years in business. Use when a homeowner wants someone for a home job, like snow removal, lawn care, junk removal, painting or plumbing.

job.description: The work, like "snow removal", "junk removal", "painting" or "roofing".

tools.name: start_request
tools.description: A link to send a home job on ChoreOFF with the job and ZIP filled in. The homeowner adds details, picks up to 3 local pros and gets prices, free. Nothing is sent until they finish on the site. Use when a homeowner wants quotes or help with a home job.

job.description: The work, like "snow removal", "junk removal", "painting" or "roofing".

tools.name: price_guide
tools.description: The usual price range for a home service job in the U.S. from published cost guides, with sources, and a link to get real prices from local pros. Use when someone asks what a home job like lawn mowing, snow removal or gutter cleaning costs.

job.description: The work, like "snow removal", "junk removal", "painting" or "roofing".
